boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Saint Xavier University
boards.description: Ten currently documented late-hour, all-ages restaurant destinations in the wider South Side and nearby suburbs.

cards.title: Wendy's at 8302 S Ashland
cards.subtitle: Chicago, IL 60620
cards.notes: Check the restaurant-hours table before leaving; this location lists dining and drive-thru service into the early morning on every day.
cards.short_summary: A Chicago Wendy's with posted service through 3:00 or 3:30 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours until 3:00 AM daily, extending to 3:30 AM on Friday and Saturday, at 8302 S Ashland.
cards.access_notes: Posted restaurant hours: 6:30 AM–3:00 AM Monday–Thursday and Sunday; 6:30/7:00 AM–3:30 AM Friday–Saturday. Drive-thru lists the same closing times; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Taco Bell at 7906 S Western
cards.subtitle: Chicago, IL 60620
cards.notes: Use the location page to distinguish drive-thru from dining-room hours, then plan a late order around the posted overnight drive-thru schedule.
cards.short_summary: A South Western Avenue Taco Bell with drive-thru hours as late as 3:00 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours until 2:00 AM or 3:00 AM, depending on day, at 7906 S Western Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is posted until 2:00 AM Sunday–Wednesday and 3:00 AM Thursday–Saturday. The dining room closes earlier; confirm the day before travel.

cards.title: Taco Bell at 9540 S Cicero
cards.subtitle: Oak Lawn, IL 60453
cards.notes: Treat the drive-thru and dining room as separate options: the official page posts overnight drive-thru access while indoor service ends earlier.
cards.short_summary: An Oak Lawn Taco Bell with 3:00–4:00 AM posted drive-thru closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours until 3:00 AM Sunday–Thursday and 4:00 AM Friday–Saturday at 9540 S Cicero Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru hours are posted to 3:00 AM Sunday–Thursday and 4:00 AM Friday–Saturday; the dining room is posted to 10:00 PM. Verify before going.

cards.title: Taco Bell at 7601 W 111th
cards.subtitle: Palos Hills, IL 60465
cards.notes: For a westbound late stop, check the day-specific drive-thru schedule on the official page and do not assume indoor seating remains open.
cards.short_summary: A Palos Hills drive-thru option posted until 1:00 or 2:00 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours until 1:00 AM Sunday–Thursday and 2:00 AM Friday–Saturday at 7601 W 111th Street.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru closes at 1:00 AM Sunday–Thursday and 2:00 AM Friday–Saturday. The dining room is posted to 10:00 PM; confirm current availability.

cards.title: Taco Bell at 11750 S Palaski
cards.subtitle: Alsip, IL 60803
cards.notes: Keep this as a late drive-thru or delivery destination; the page posts a midnight dining-room close but much later drive-thru hours.
cards.short_summary: An Alsip Taco Bell with a 4:00 AM daily posted drive-thru close.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours from 9:00 AM until 4:00 AM every day at 11750 South Palaski Road.
cards.access_notes: Official hours list drive-thru service until 4:00 AM daily. The restaurant page lists dine-in only until 12:00 AM; check for changes before departing.

cards.title: Wendy's at 758 W 117th
cards.subtitle: Chicago, IL 60628
cards.notes: Check the day before a late run: the location page posts 1:00 AM most nights and 2:00 AM Thursday through Saturday for both service modes.
cards.short_summary: A 117th Street Wendy's with posted 1:00–2:00 AM service.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours until 1:00 AM Sunday–Wednesday and 2:00 AM Thursday–Saturday at 758 West 117th Street.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru hours are posted to 1:00 AM Sunday–Wednesday and 2:00 AM Thursday–Saturday. Holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Wendy's at 11110 S Cicero
cards.subtitle: Alsip, IL 60803
cards.notes: Use the official location page as the final check; it posts the same 2:00 AM close for restaurant and drive-thru service throughout the week.
cards.short_summary: An Alsip Wendy's with a uniform 2:00 AM posted close.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours from 10:00 AM until 2:00 AM every day at 11110 S Cicero Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are both posted 10:00 AM–2:00 AM daily. Holiday hours may vary, so verify immediately before a late visit.

cards.title: Wendy's at 3516 E 118th
cards.subtitle: Chicago, IL 60617
cards.notes: Confirm the day-specific schedule and choose restaurant or drive-thru service; both are listed into the early morning at this East 118th Street location.
cards.short_summary: An East 118th Street Wendy's open past 2:00 AM daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours until 2:30 AM Sunday–Thursday and 3:00 AM Friday–Saturday at 3516 E 118th Street.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru hours are posted to 2:30 AM Sunday–Thursday and 3:00 AM Friday–Saturday. Holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Wendy's at 7031 S Western
cards.subtitle: Chicago, IL 60636
cards.notes: Use this as a documented overnight food option only after checking the live location page; both dining and drive-thru schedules vary by day.
cards.short_summary: A South Western Avenue Wendy's posted until 1:00 or 2:00 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours until 1:00 AM Sunday–Wednesday and 2:00 AM Thursday–Saturday at 7031 South Western Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru close at 1:00 AM Sunday–Wednesday and 2:00 AM Thursday–Saturday, according to the location page; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Wendy's at 145 S Western
cards.subtitle: Chicago, IL 60612
cards.notes: For a destination with the broadest posted availability, consult the official page on the day of travel; it lists both restaurant and drive-thru as open 24 hours.
cards.short_summary: A Chicago Wendy's officially listed as open 24 hours every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru service as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday at 145 S Western Avenue.
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists both restaurant and drive-thru as open 24 hours every day. Check for temporary or holiday changes before traveling.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing

cards.subtitle: Shannon Center · current SXU ID required
cards.notes: Bring your Cougar ID, sign in at the front desk, and choose cardio or strength equipment for a self-paced workout with a friend.

cards.evidence_claim: The Shannon Center lists a Fitness Center and says the private facility is free for SXU students with a current Cougar ID.
cards.source_title: The Shannon Center | Saint Xavier University
cards.access_notes: SXU students need a current Cougar ID and must sign in and swipe in at the Shannon Center front desk.

cards.title: Walk the Indoor Running Track
cards.subtitle: Shannon Center · current SXU ID required

cards.title: Play Racquetball at Shannon

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct SXU study environments, from library rooms to residence-hall and Warde Academic Center spaces.

cards.entity_name: Robert and Mary Rita Murphy Stump Library
cards.title: Robert and Mary Rita Murphy Stump Library
cards.subtitle: Warde Academic Center, L-228
cards.notes: Start here when you need research tools close at hand: use the desktop computers, scanners, printers, and librarian assistance for a project work session.
cards.short_summary: A full-service library workspace with research help and equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU says the library has desktop computers, printers, scanners, quiet and group study rooms, and staff research assistance.
cards.source_title: Robert and Mary Rita Murphy Stump Library | Saint Xavier University
cards.access_notes: No food is allowed in the library; drinks with covers are permitted. Check the library website for current hours.

cards.title: Stump Library Quiet Study Area
cards.subtitle: Inside Stump Library, Warde Academic Center
cards.notes: Bring a covered drink and settle into the library’s main quiet-study area for reading, drafting, or other work that benefits from a lower-distraction setting.
cards.short_summary: The library’s designated quiet-study environment.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU identifies a main Quiet Study Area in its library and notes that covered drinks are permitted while food is not.
cards.source_title: Parent A to Z Guide and Information | Saint Xavier University
cards.access_notes: Located in Stump Library. No food; covered drinks are permitted. Consult library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Stump Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Upper level of Stump Library
cards.notes: Use one of the upstairs group rooms when your assignment needs conversation: coordinate with your group first and check room availability through SXU reservations.
cards.short_summary: Upstairs library rooms designed for group work.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU’s parent guide states that Stump Library has 10 group study rooms upstairs; its campus map identifies Library Group Study Rooms.
cards.source_title: Parent A to Z Guide and Information | Saint Xavier University
cards.access_notes: SXU directs users to Room Reservations to check study-space availability; verify date and availability before going.

cards.title: Stump Library Lower-Level Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Lower level, Stump Library
cards.notes: Choose a lower-level study room for a smaller work session, then use the nearby library stacks to pull print materials as your research takes shape.
cards.short_summary: Three study rooms adjacent to the library’s lower-level stacks.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU states that Stump Library has three study rooms on its lower level; the Warde map labels the lower-level Library Stacks.
cards.source_title: Parent A to Z Guide and Information | Saint Xavier University
cards.access_notes: Use SXU Room Reservations to check availability. Library food and drink rules apply.

cards.title: The Link
cards.subtitle: Second-floor connection between McCarthy and Rubloff Halls
cards.notes: Read or review notes in this second-floor connector overlooking Schmidt Quad; if you live elsewhere on campus, sign in at the Rubloff front desk first.
cards.short_summary: A quiet reading and study connector with a quad view.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU describes The Link as a quiet study or reading space between McCarthy and Rubloff Halls that overlooks Schmidt Quad.
cards.access_notes: Designed for residents. Residents not living in Rubloff or McCarthy may access it by signing in at the Rubloff Hall front desk.

cards.title: Morris Hall 24/7 Student Room
cards.subtitle: Morris Hall
cards.notes: Use this around-the-clock student room when you need campus internet and University services from a residence-hall setting; bring your own study materials.
cards.short_summary: A Morris Hall student room with 24/7 internet access.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU states that students can connect to the internet and other University services in Morris Hall’s 24/7 Student Room.
cards.access_notes: SXU describes the room as 24/7; confirm residence-hall access requirements with Residence Life.

cards.title: Pacelli Hall Study Lounges
cards.subtitle: Each floor of Pacelli Hall
cards.notes: Pick the floor lounge nearest your room for an informal study block; each study lounge includes a microwave, useful when you plan a longer session.
cards.short_summary: Residence-hall study lounges available on every Pacelli floor.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU lists study lounges on each floor of Pacelli Hall and says they include microwaves.
cards.access_notes: Located within Pacelli Hall; confirm residence-hall guest and building-access rules with Residence Life.

cards.title: Warde Academic Center Atrium
cards.subtitle: First floor, Warde Academic Center
cards.notes: Use the atrium as a central meeting point before class, then spread out for coursework near the building’s library, computer labs, lounges, and support offices.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor Warde gathering space among academic resources.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU’s Warde Academic Center map labels an Atrium, and SXU describes Warde as a primary location for studying with library, lounges, and computer labs.
cards.access_notes: Located in Warde Academic Center. Consult SXU building access information and event schedules before planning a session.

cards.title: Wiseman Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: L-105, Warde Academic Center
cards.notes: Set up in this named Warde lounge for a campus-based work block, then move easily to nearby student support, computer lab, library, or classroom resources.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed student lounge in the academic center.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU’s current Warde Academic Center map labels the Wiseman Student Lounge as L-105.
cards.access_notes: L-105 in Warde Academic Center. Check building access and any scheduled use before relying on the lounge.

cards.title: Warde Academic Center Outdoor Seating
cards.subtitle: First-floor outdoor seating, Warde Academic Center
cards.notes: Take reading or a laptop outside at the map-listed seating area when weather permits, with Warde’s library, computer labs, and student resources close by.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed outdoor option beside Warde’s academic amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU’s current Warde Academic Center map labels Outdoor Seating, and SXU describes Warde as a location for studying with library and computer-lab resources.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor use depends on weather and campus conditions; use Warde’s indoor spaces as an alternative.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Named public destinations on the Western Avenue, 111th Street, Seeley Avenue, and 87th Street corridors near Saint Xavier University.

cards.title: Dan Ryan Woods Visitor Center
cards.subtitle: Western Avenue corridor near 87th Street
cards.notes: Use the visitor center as a clearly marked starting point for a daytime walk; the Forest Preserves map places it within Dan Ryan Woods.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed trailhead landmark in Dan Ryan Woods.
cards.evidence_claim: The Forest Preserves of Cook County map labels the Dan Ryan Woods Visitor Center on the Western Avenue corridor near 87th Street.
cards.source_title: Dan Ryan Woods Athletic Fields Map
cards.access_notes: Use during posted preserve hours; follow onsite trail and facility signage.

cards.title: Dan Ryan Sledding Hill
cards.subtitle: Western Avenue corridor near 87th Street
cards.notes: Locate the named Sledding Hill on the preserve map before heading out, and use it only when seasonal conditions and posted rules allow.
cards.short_summary: A specifically labeled outdoor feature in the woods.
cards.evidence_claim: The Forest Preserves of Cook County map identifies a Dan Ryan Sledding Hill within Dan Ryan Woods.
cards.source_title: Dan Ryan Woods Picnic Groves Map
cards.access_notes: Seasonal use; check conditions and obey posted preserve rules.

cards.title: Dan Ryan Woods Pavilion
cards.subtitle: Western Avenue corridor near 87th Street
cards.notes: Use the pavilion as an easy landmark for finding the central grove area, then continue on designated paths rather than cutting across grounds.
cards.short_summary: A named pavilion within the Dan Ryan Woods map area.
cards.evidence_claim: The Forest Preserves of Cook County map labels the Dan Ryan Woods Pavilion in Dan Ryan Woods.
cards.source_title: Dan Ryan Woods Athletic Fields Map
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access is subject to preserve rules and any reserved-event activity.

cards.title: Walker Branch
cards.subtitle: West 110th Street corridor
cards.notes: Plan a library stop around its current branch schedule, and take time to view the historic exterior before heading along the 110th Street corridor.
cards.short_summary: A historic Chicago Public Library branch serving nearby south-side communities.
cards.evidence_claim: Chicago Public Library says Walker Branch serves Beverly, Morgan Park, Mount Greenwood, West Beverly, and West Pullman, and its exterior dates to 1890.
cards.access_notes: Check the branch location page for current hours and program availability.

cards.title: Beverly Branch
cards.subtitle: 95th Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the branch’s location page to time a visit, then pair a library stop with a walk along the 95th Street corridor.
cards.short_summary: A named Chicago Public Library branch on the Beverly corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Chicago Public Library maintains a current location page for its Beverly Branch.
cards.access_notes: Check the official location page for current hours, services, and programs.

cards.title: Ridge Historical Society
cards.subtitle: Seeley Avenue corridor at 106th Street
cards.notes: Visit during the society’s listed public hours to see local-history exhibits, and confirm any holiday exceptions before making the Seeley Avenue trip.
cards.short_summary: A local-history stop with changing exhibits.
cards.evidence_claim: Ridge Historical Society lists its address as 10621 S. Seeley Avenue and describes an exhibit on the Ridge Historic District.
cards.access_notes: The society lists public visits Tuesday and Sunday, 1–4 p.m.; verify before travel.

cards.title: Beverly Arts Center
cards.subtitle: 111th Street corridor at Western Avenue
cards.notes: Check the center’s event calendar before going, then use its 111th Street location as a corridor anchor for an arts-focused outing.
cards.short_summary: A named arts venue on the 111th Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: A City of Chicago public meeting notice identifies Beverly Arts Center at 2407 W. 111th Street.
cards.source_title: Community Commission for Public Safety and Accountability Meeting Minutes
cards.access_notes: Event access and ticket requirements vary; consult the arts center’s current calendar.

cards.title: Kennedy (Dennis) Park
cards.subtitle: Western Avenue corridor at 113th Street
cards.notes: Use the park’s paths, courts, or fieldhouse area during open hours, and check the Park District page for the facilities operating that day.
cards.short_summary: A City park with paths, courts, and recreation facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Chicago Park District lists Kennedy (Dennis) Park at 11320 S. Western Ave. and identifies paths, courts, fields, and a fieldhouse among its facilities.
cards.access_notes: The Park District lists park hours as 6 a.m.–11 p.m. daily; individual facilities and programs vary.

cards.title: Mount Greenwood Park
cards.subtitle: 111th Street corridor at 37th Avenue
cards.notes: Choose a listed facility such as the playground, tennis court, or paths, and verify seasonal programs before using the 111th Street park.
cards.short_summary: A large public park with multiple documented recreation facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Chicago Park District lists Mount Greenwood Park at 3721 W. 111th St. and documents playground, tennis, fieldhouse, pool, and other facilities.
cards.access_notes: The Park District lists park hours as 6 a.m.–11 p.m. daily; seasonal facilities may differ.

cards.entity_name: Chicago High School for Agricultural Sciences
cards.title: Chicago High School for Agricultural Sciences
cards.subtitle: 111th Street corridor at 39th Avenue
cards.notes: Use the public 111th Street frontage as a recognizable corridor landmark; do not enter school grounds unless you have a permitted school-related reason.
cards.short_summary: A public magnet high school dedicated to agricultural education.
cards.evidence_claim: Chicago High School for Agricultural Sciences identifies its campus at 3857 W. 111th Street and states that students study agriculture.
cards.source_title: Chicago High School for Agricultural Sciences: Mission and Vision
cards.access_notes: School buildings and grounds are not general public-access destinations; view from public rights-of-way unless authorized.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten recurring Saint Xavier University observances documented by SXU, from first-year induction through graduation.

cards.entity_name: Cougar Trax and New Student Induction
cards.title: Cougar Trax and New Student Induction
cards.subtitle: Saint Xavier University • Before fall classes
cards.notes: If you are an incoming first-year student, look for Cougar Trax details before classes begin and plan around its two-day welcome and induction program.
cards.short_summary: SXU’s pre-semester first-year welcome program includes First-Year Fest and New Student Induction.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU describes Cougar Trax as a two-day program held the Thursday and Friday before classes begin; it includes First-Year Fest and New Student Induction.
cards.access_notes: Designed for new first-year students; SXU says the program includes mandatory programming.

cards.title: RSO Fair
cards.subtitle: Saint Xavier University • Welcome Week and Winter Week
cards.notes: Bring a short list of interests, then use the fair to meet registered student organizations and compare ways to take part during the semester.
cards.short_summary: A twice-yearly SXU gathering for discovering registered student organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU states that its RSO Fair occurs once per semester, on the Wednesday of Welcome Week and Winter Week, and introduces registered student organizations.
cards.access_notes: SXU invites the entire campus community and says snacks are provided; confirm the current event listing for details.

cards.title: Spirit of Mercy Day
cards.subtitle: Saint Xavier University • September
cards.notes: Attend the community liturgy or related programming to see SXU connect its academic year with its Sisters of Mercy heritage.
cards.short_summary: A September SXU observance blending the Mass of the Holy Spirit with Mercy Day.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU says Spirit of Mercy Day is celebrated each September and regularly includes a special Eucharistic liturgy, leader commissioning and conversations with Sisters of Mercy guests.
cards.access_notes: Programming involves the SXU community; consult SXU’s current calendar for the year’s schedule.

cards.title: SXU Homecoming
cards.subtitle: Saint Xavier University • Annual fall celebration
cards.notes: Check the published Homecoming schedule for campus events, then join the appropriate student, alumni or community activities during the week.
cards.short_summary: An annual SXU celebration that brings students, alumni, faculty, staff and friends together.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU calls Homecoming a tradition connecting generations of Cougars and documents an annual weeklong celebration with events for students, alumni, faculty and staff.
cards.access_notes: Activities have different audiences; SXU’s 2025 notice specified that student activities were for students, while some events welcomed alumni or the community.

cards.title: Finals Breakfast
cards.subtitle: Saint Xavier University • Fall and spring finals weeks
cards.notes: Mark the Monday of finals week and check Student Activities updates if you want to join the campus breakfast before studying.
cards.short_summary: A Student Activities breakfast tradition scheduled during each fall and spring finals week.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU says Finals Breakfast takes place on the Monday of Finals Week in both fall and spring semesters and is prepared by Student Activities staff.
cards.access_notes: SXU lists pancakes, sausage and other breakfast items; verify current timing and dietary information with Student Activities.

cards.title: Mission Day
cards.subtitle: Saint Xavier University • Selected date each March
cards.notes: Attend the awards presentation to see student, staff and faculty service recognized as part of SXU’s Mercy-centered mission observance.
cards.short_summary: A March university-wide observance centered on service awards and SXU’s mission.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU states that Mission Day is celebrated on a selected March date and features annual service awards for a student, staff member and faculty member.
cards.access_notes: SXU says the awards presentation is attended by recipients’ families, guests and university community members; confirm the date and attendance details.

cards.title: Late Nite
cards.subtitle: Saint Xavier University • Spring semester
cards.notes: Watch for the spring announcement and choose from the activities offered that year, which SXU says have included games, crafts, sports and food.
cards.short_summary: An annual spring student event with rotating activities and food.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU identifies Late Nite as an annual spring-semester event open to SXU students and lists past activities including bingo, crafts, sports contests and food.
cards.access_notes: Open to SXU students. The official page does not provide a current start or end time; consult the current event listing.

cards.title: Taste of SXU
cards.subtitle: Saint Xavier University • Spring semester
cards.notes: Look for the spring event announcement and explore the participating food offerings as SXU’s Student Activities Board presents its campus Taste of Chicago version.
cards.short_summary: A spring food event coordinated by SXU’s Student Activities Board.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU describes Taste of SXU as its version of the Taste of Chicago, coordinated by the Student Activities Board and held during the spring semester.
cards.access_notes: SXU identifies the event as spring-semester programming; confirm the current date, location and participation details.

cards.title: Scarlet and Gray Awards
cards.subtitle: Saint Xavier University • Last week of spring semester
cards.notes: Follow Student Activities updates near semester’s end to recognize campus leadership, service and extracurricular involvement through this annual ceremony.
cards.short_summary: SXU’s annual ceremony recognizing student leadership, service and extracurricular involvement.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU states that the Scarlet and Gray Awards Ceremony recognizes student achievement in leadership, service and extracurricular involvement and occurs annually during the last spring-semester week.
cards.access_notes: Timing is listed as the last week of the spring semester; consult SXU for the current ceremony details.

cards.title: Commencement Liturgy
cards.subtitle: Saint Xavier University • Graduation season
cards.notes: Graduates and families can check commencement communications for the special liturgy that reflects on collegiate years and marks departure from SXU.
cards.short_summary: A special Eucharistic liturgy held alongside SXU graduation ceremonies.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU states that, in conjunction with each graduation ceremony, it hosts graduates and their families for a special Eucharistic liturgy honoring their collegiate years.
cards.access_notes: Held in conjunction with graduation ceremonies for graduates and their families; verify the current commencement schedule and attendance guidance.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Saint Xavier University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A campus-first, under-21-safe sequence of named SXU places for getting oriented, settling in, and finding support.

cards.title: Start with a Warde Academic Center walk-through
cards.subtitle: Campus hub · Friday arrival
cards.notes: Use the building directory and map to locate the library, dining, lounges and student resources before choosing where to return later.
cards.short_summary: Get your bearings in SXU’s main academic and student-activity hub.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU identifies the Warde Academic Center as the hub for classes, student gatherings, studying and events, with dining, library and student-resource spaces.
cards.access_notes: Use the official campus map for building navigation; specific room access may vary.

cards.title: Handle your Cougar Card at The Hub
cards.subtitle: Warde Academic Center L-121 · Friday
cards.notes: Stop by to resolve a campus-technology question or ask about your Cougar Card, then keep the location handy for later support.
cards.short_summary: A named first-stop for campus technology help and Cougar Card questions.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU lists The Hub in Warde Academic Center L-121 as the first line of support for university technology issues and Cougar Card help.
cards.source_title: Parent A to Z Guide and Information
cards.access_notes: Contact or desk availability is not stated on the source page; check with SXU before making a special trip.

cards.entity_name: Robert and Mary Rita Murphy Stump Library
cards.title: Choose a study spot in Stump Library
cards.subtitle: Warde Academic Center L-Wing · Friday afternoon
cards.notes: Tour the quiet and group-study areas, then bookmark the research-help option for your first assignment or a future project.
cards.short_summary: Explore SXU’s library spaces, computers, study rooms and research support.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU states that Stump Library has computers, printers, scanners, quiet and group study rooms, and research assistance.
cards.source_title: Robert and Mary Rita Murphy Stump Library
cards.access_notes: The library is for SXU-affiliated users and certain CARLI visitors with ID; verify library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Have a first campus meal at the Main Diner
cards.subtitle: Warde Academic Center, first floor · Friday evening
cards.notes: Meet a classmate for a meal, then note the diner’s weekend schedule so you can plan around campus dining when classes begin.
cards.short_summary: A campus dining stop serving breakfast, lunch and dinner.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU lists the Country House Main Diner on Warde’s first floor and says it is open for breakfast, lunch and dinner.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Mon–Fri 7:30 a.m.–7 p.m.; weekends and holidays 10 a.m.–6 p.m. Purchases or meal-plan funds are needed.

cards.title: Use the Morris Hall Starbucks as an evening meet-up
cards.subtitle: Morris Hall, first floor · Friday evening
cards.notes: If its posted hours fit your arrival, use this named campus stop for a nonalcoholic drink and a low-key conversation before settling in.
cards.short_summary: A Friday-evening campus coffee stop in Morris Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU lists a Starbucks on the first floor of Morris Hall and posts Friday hours through 4 p.m. and Sunday hours from 2 to 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Mon–Thu 7 a.m.–10 p.m.; Fri 7 a.m.–4 p.m.; Sun 2–10 p.m.; closed Saturday. Purchases are required.

cards.title: Take a quiet pause at McDonough Chapel
cards.subtitle: Campus Ministry · Saturday or Sunday
cards.notes: Use the chapel’s posted prayer or Mass schedule to plan a reflective visit, respecting the space and any active service in progress.
cards.short_summary: A campus chapel with scheduled prayer, Mass and individual-prayer time.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU posts Daily Prayer, Wednesday Mass and Sunday Mass at McDonough Chapel, along with weekday individual-prayer availability.
cards.access_notes: Posted individual-prayer access is Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–4 p.m.; the chapel is closed Saturday. Sunday Mass is posted 7–8 p.m.

cards.title: Get acquainted with the Shannon Center
cards.subtitle: Campus recreation · Saturday
cards.notes: Bring your current Cougar ID and ask about group exercise or intramural opportunities that match your interests and schedule.
cards.short_summary: An 85,000-square-foot campus recreation and event facility.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU describes the Shannon Center as a private 85,000-square-foot facility and invites eligible members to take part in intramurals and group exercise classes.
cards.access_notes: SXU states the facility is free for students, faculty/staff and Sisters of Mercy with a current Cougar ID card.

cards.title: Find the Urso Outdoor Sports Center
cards.subtitle: Adjacent to Bruce R. Deaton Memorial Field · Saturday
cards.notes: Walk by the center and adjacent field to recognize the athletics area, then consult SXU athletics for any event-specific details.
cards.short_summary: A named athletics facility beside SXU’s football and soccer field.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU states that the Urso Outdoor Sports Center is adjacent to Bruce R. Deaton Memorial Field, where Cougar football and soccer play.
cards.access_notes: Facility and event access are not specified on this source; confirm before entering or attending an event.

cards.title: Plan a Visual Arts Center visit
cards.subtitle: 10435 South Spaulding · Sunday
cards.notes: Check with SXU for current gallery access, then spend time with the student and alumni work rather than treating the visit as a quick pass-through.
cards.short_summary: An SXU art facility dedicated to showcasing student and alumni artwork.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU identifies the Visual Arts Center at 10435 South Spaulding as a space dedicated to showcasing student and alumni artwork.
cards.access_notes: Located off campus; the source does not state public gallery hours, admission, or transportation arrangements.

cards.title: Keep Rhubarb’s in mind for a late snack
cards.subtitle: McCarthy Hall · Sunday evening
cards.notes: If you need a convenient campus food stop, check the posted selection and use the current closing time to plan a simple evening pickup.
cards.short_summary: A named campus convenience and grab-and-go food location.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU describes Rhubarb’s in McCarthy Hall as a convenience store with grab-and-go options and posts daily evening hours.
cards.access_notes: SXU posts Rhubarb’s as open seven days a week, 6–11 p.m. Purchases or meal-plan funds are needed.
